sentences.text: The first periodical report as ordered by this Court has been filed on record along with the memo of the learned Government Pleader dated 13.01.2025.
various actions of the Authority have been mentioned therein.
The learned counsel for the petitioner seeks some time to go through the report and makes submissions.
I, therefore, adjourn this matter to be called on 20.03.2025 with a direction to the respondents to file the next report indicating further action by them.
This application to correct the judgment is not opposed by the learned Government Pleader.
The Registry will make consequential corrections in the judgment and release the corrected judgment to the parties as per usual procedure.
